issues.comparison_statistic: No raw per-seed curves, exact plotting normalization, matched test windows or per-case scalar acceptance targets were located. Plot endpoints are not native episode returns. Test time labelled 0..1 does not identify physical duration.
issues.training_recipe: Paper gives shared descriptions/ranges, not complete recipes for all cases. Exact seed values, checkpoint selection, normalization calibration, per-case hyperparameters and stopping budgets remain unresolved.
issues.replay_protocol: Exact initialization/phase schedule, gust/target trajectories, evaluation repetitions, inference action convention, physical averaging window and solver boundary semantics require executable binding. Changing only RNG seed is not a new deterministic flow state.
issues.timing: Paper CFD iteration counts differ from Hub YAML. Check base/fine-grid subcycling and physical dt before changing counts; a numerical count mismatch alone does not establish a physical-time mismatch.
issues.sensing: Public configurable/default probes and action normalization do not establish final-paper sensor coordinates, ordering, physical amplitudes or smoothing constants.
issues.pinball_omega: SI requires omega=1; every selected MAIA Pinball YAML uses omega=0. Old author code also used drag column twice in its reward. Current platform fixes columns but YAML still removes lift penalty.
issues.cavity_reward: SI Eq.36 uses squared normalized probe error; current MAIA get_reward uses absolute normalized error. Running-mean variant is not the fixed paper target. Reference calibration/variance provenance remains unresolved.
issues.three_dimensional_forces: Current cube/sphere code adds both transverse force absolute penalties; SI refers to drag/lift framework without an explicit separate side-force prescription. Resolve coefficients and force normalizations.
issues.sphere_actuation: SI specifies eight jets; selected Hub YAML declares ten action inputs. Resolve actual solver jet IDs and action mapping before accepting either as a paper match.
issues.gust_protocol: omega=0.25 and G=2 are reported; exact gust timing and reference averaging window are not recovered. Selected gust YAML substeps lie outside the SI stated 225..1000 range. Fig.2c positive training rewards need reconciliation with nonpositive Eq.37. Its Re1000/AOA20/3D result cannot transfer to selected Re10000/50000 cases.
issues.steady_naca_target: Native non-gust CL/CD objective is identified from code, not an exact learned-policy result in SI 5E. Do not reuse gust or Nek wing skin-friction targets.
issues.dra_objective: SI jet has one degree of freedom and net-power-saving reward. YAML has ten inputs; native jet reward is -CD with C_P=0. Physical amplitude scaling and energy cost are unresolved.
issues.kolmogorov_objective: Hub YAML Re40 vs platform default Re200 vs related author example Re250. Fig.3b exact Re unknown. Native reward is -(alpha*TKE + L1(action)), alpha=0 by default; it does not reward enhanced mixing. Observation/transition lag and solver corrections also differ; see JAX_RECONSTRUCTION.md.
issues.gppo: No exact final-paper adaptive gradient/entropy weighting or complete GPPO trainer located. Eq.34 reward augmentation and GI-PPO are not established substitutes for the Fig.3b Eq.32 trajectory-gradient experiment.
issues.jax_channel: SI describes finite-difference DNS, adaptive dt and shear ratio; platform class is pseudo-spectral with -wall_shear reward. YAML vs class defaults differ. State.time increments nsteps although horizon comment says RL steps. Reconcile actual solver, observation, forcing and horizon semantics.
issues.nek_case_identity: Paper learned-control transfer uses open channel Re_tau206, domain 2pi x 1 x pi and N=7. Selected TCFmini Re180 YAML has another domain/discretization. Re180 SI Fig.19 is uncontrolled validation; 38% wing reduction is not its policy score.
issues.nozzle_protocol: Ninj=8 appears as an illustration, not a uniquely fixed recipe; selected 3D YAML omits required num_actuators. Exact reference trajectory, time horizon, seeds and action schedule unspecified. Native reward radians vs validation figure degrees. Source 2D SPR0.9 differs from Fig.23 validation SPR0.7.
issues.firedrake_binding: SI 3F specifies a negative time-integrated objective as reward. Assets identify Re/mesh but not final-paper RL replay protocol. Native flow objectives differ from MAIA reward formulas. Must verify wrapper implementation against that integration rule and bind sensor/action layout and physical control interval separately; never copy MAIA CFD step counts.
issues.result_identity: Related paper result has different dimension/Re/actuation/solver or objective; no direct acceptance transfer is allowed.
